transferMechanism.notes: California is not an NLC member (confirmed via CA's own per-state fact record), so every out-of-state RN, including from New York, must obtain a single-state CA license via endorsement.

endorsementProcess.value: Apply through the BRN's endorsement process (BreEZe online system); verify the New York license and original licensing state via Nursys; complete Live Scan (in-state) or FD-258 card (out-of-state) fingerprinting through California DOJ/FBI.

exceptions.value: California law (16 CCR 1410.5, effective October 2023) exempts applicants who have completed CA's required anatomy/physiology/microbiology theory coursework and have at least 2 years of RN practice in another state from the laboratory-component requirement that otherwise applies to out-of-state applicants.
